caption: What if your reflexes were 10x faster? A typical human reacts to something they see in about 0.25 seconds. Cut that to 0.025 seconds and a phone slipping out of your hand would fall only about 3 mm before you grab it, instead of about 31 cm. A 150 km/h bouncer takes roughly half a second to reach the batter; with 10x reflexes you would be reacting when the ball had moved just 1 metre. An auto at 60 km/h covers about 4 metres in 0.25 seconds, but only about 40 cm in 0.025. The twist: in a sprint final you would be disqualified. World Athletics timing systems flag any reaction under 0.1 seconds off the blocks as a false start, because no human is supposed to be that quick. What would YOU use 10x reflexes for? 👇
